Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era

description:
Natural Azurite & Malachite Specimen
Raw Mineral Display Rock
Natural Mineral, Approximately 5.5 Inches, 2.05 Pounds
This natural geological specimen showcases vibrant royal blue botryoidal azurite formations intergrown with rich green malachite across a dark gossan rock matrix. Azurite and malachite are secondary copper carbonate minerals prized for their intense coloration and contrasting visual texture. Specimens featuring intact crystal vugs and natural matrix presentation make exceptional display pieces for mineral collectors and natural history enthusiasts.
Features deep blue botryoidal azurite nodules and bright green malachite deposits
Solid natural matrix with exposed crystal vug on front face
Measures approximately 5.5 inches tall by 5 inches wide by 3 inches deep
Weight: approximately 2.05 pounds (2 lbs 1 oz)
Condition:
Natural rough mineral specimen in as-found unpolished condition. Crystal pockets show sharp natural formations and vibrant color with no visible artificial treatment or repair. Matrix is stable with typical natural fracturing and minor crumb shedding inherent to raw mineral rock.

Natural Mineral Specimen Lot of 2
Amethyst Quartz Cluster & Cut Base Green Fluorite
2 Pieces
This lot of two natural geological specimens features an amethyst quartz crystal geode cluster and a substantial rough green fluorite display piece with a sawn flat base. The amethyst specimen exhibits lavender to violet crystalline points resting atop a layered agate and basalt matrix band. The companion green fluorite specimen displays pale seafoam to emerald-green translucent crystalline mass with natural rough cleavage and mineral veining, cut flat on the bottom and back for upright shelf or tabletop display.
Includes two distinct natural mineral display specimens
Amethyst cluster features defined crystalline druzy terminations and agate banding
Green fluorite specimen features cut flat base and back for stable freestanding display
Suitable for mineral collectors, lapidary display, or natural interior accents

Raw Mineral & Rock Specimen Lot
Natural Geological Collection
5 Pieces
This assorted collection of five unpolished geological rock and mineral specimens features diverse textures, crystal formations, and mineral compositions. Ranging from crystalline aggregates to metamorphic and mineralized ore samples, this lot is well suited for educational study, earth science reference, or natural decorative display.
Items Included:
Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones
Coarse-grained crystalline rock specimen with quartz and feldspar matrix
Orange blocky cleavage specimen exhibiting distinct crystal planes
Elongated foliated metamorphic stone with visible mineral layering
Dense mineral ore rock with reddish-brown oxidation and dark metallic tones

All five specimens are in natural, rough raw condition as collected. Surfaces exhibit natural fractures, irregular cleavage edges, natural sediment, and mineral veining. Free of artificial polishing or tumbling.

description:
Swirled Slag Glass Cullet Specimen
Cullet Art Glass Rough Chunk
Mid-Century Style, Vintage
This striking slag glass cullet chunk displays vibrant bands of white, blue, turquoise, yellow, and orange swirled throughout layered glass matrix. Originating as foundry cullet or marble works byproduct, this dense decorative glass specimen features intricate bullseye banding, agate-style marbling, and raw fractured edges prized by lapidary artisans and glass collectors.
Multi-colored slag glass cullet with natural conchoidal fractures and raw textured surfaces
Prominent swirls of opaque white, translucent blue, green, and vibrant accent colors
Suitable as a decorative specimen, paperweight, bookend, or lapidary rough material
Measures approximately 4.5" x 4.5" x 4" and weighs 2.5 lbs
Condition:
Very good raw vintage condition. Displays characteristic rough cullet features including natural conchoidal fracture planes, sharp cleavage points, and factory kiln inclusions. Glass surfaces remain vibrant and stable with light earthen residue in recessed crevices consistent with salvaged glass rough.

Rough Raw Rocks & Crystals
Natural Geological Specimens
This collection features six individual rough mineral and rock specimens displaying natural crystal formations, cleavage planes, and varied mineral compositions. Large crystalline specimen with striated cleavage faces and matrix rock

SHIPPING - All items ship via FedEx from our Indianapolis warehouse unless otherwise indicated in the item listing. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). We are unable to ship to APO or military addresses. Please allow 5 business days ( Monday-Friday) for your purchase to be shipped.
Please note: we no longer offer shipping to Canada.
THANK YOU for shopping with Goodwill of Central and Southern Indiana, we appreciate your business.

description: This lot includes three vintage tobacco pipes with distinct designs and materials. The first pipe has a corn cob bowl, wooden shank, and plastic stem, . The second is a classic straight briar wood pipe with a smooth finish and black stem, exhibiting surface scuffs and discoloration. The third pipe is a bent briar wood pipe with a reddish-brown stem featuring a pronounced curve. See photos for conditions , and stains also damages.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

description:
Natural Purple Amethyst Cluster
Mineral Geode Specimen with Cut Flat Base
Natural Amethyst Quartz, 5 Inches Tall, 1.6 lbs
This natural purple amethyst crystal geode cluster specimen features a dense formation of sparkling crystalline quartz points lining an interior cavity. Characterized by rich violet tones, the formation exhibits concentric agate and quartz matrix banding along its natural rock rind. Cut with a level base, it stands freely for upright presentation as an earth science specimen, altar stone, or display accent.
Naturally formed amethyst quartz crystal points in rich violet hues
Natural outer rock matrix rind showcasing surrounding agate banding
Cut flat base allows for stable, upright tabletop or shelf display
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 4 inches long, 3 inches wide; weighs 1.6 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen with inherent crystal matrix variations, natural terminations, and rough rock textures. No artificial repairs or synthetic coatings observed. Cut base is stable and sits flat for upright display.

description:
Natural Petrified Wood Slab Tray
Fossilized Wood Footed Trivet / Display Plaque
Natural History Specimen, Mid to Late 20th Century
This substantial petrified wood slab is cut from an authentic fossilized tree round, showcasing a mirror-polished top surface that reveals intricate concentric growth rings and vivid mineral crystallization. The stone exhibits a rich spectrum of natural tones including deep brick red, warm amber, ochre yellow, and smoky charcoal. The natural outer circumference retains its rough, textured bark-like matrix, while the underside is fitted with four applied pedestal feet for elevated tabletop use as a decorative tray, trivet, or mineral display.
Authentic petrified wood slab with high-gloss polished upper surface
Natural rugged chert/bark perimeter displaying organic texture and matrix
Underside fitted with four molded feet for stable tabletop elevation
Measures approximately 9 inches long by 8 inches wide by 2 inches high; weighs 7.6 lbs
Condition:

Natural rough variation and earthy texture along the unpolished outer edge. Feet are securely attached to the underside with minor age-appropriate scuffing.

description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
